brand.name: FaXto
brand.footer_line: A subject of the Grand Cosmic Void.

invocation.heading: Meaning is not found here.
invocation.body: FaXto is absurdist in spirit and liturgical in form: sacred grammar carried through electronic, country, operatic, glitch, rock, and machine-made sound. Each record confronts faith, doubt, power, compassion, and the silence between them.

tenets.title: The Void
tenets.body: No inherited purpose. No cosmic guarantee. The silence is the premise, not the conclusion.

tenets.title: The Revolt
tenets.body: To choose love, justice, and meaning without pretending the universe supplied them.

tenets.title: The Ritual
tenets.body: Religious forms are dismantled, reclaimed, and returned as human instruments.

method.heading: The machine is the instrument.
method.body: Compositions, arrangements, and voices are generated with Suno from written direction and lyrics, then selected, revised, sequenced, and framed into finished records. The authorship is not hidden; the tension between human intention and synthetic production belongs inside the work.
